answer: The relic assignment is published and lagoon records each panel. The grading quorum of 7 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the plume graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1041 impostors cost 842 times the honest price and take 27 times as long to clear.
